**Daily Devotional**

**May 28**

*12 Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world; 13 Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ; (Titus 2:12-13 KJV)*

Paul is telling us that the Grace of God teaches us to live a separated life for Christ, and that we should live a Holy life. Notice that the Grace of God teaches us, not the wrath of God. If we get hold of the Love and Grace of God, we will want to live for Him. We should not serve God out of fear (afraid), but out of love, for fear has torment (1 John 4:18), but love conquers all things. A born again Christian should want to serve God because of our love for Him, not our being afraid of Him. The only fear we should have of God is reverence, and not being afraid.

The blessed hope is the second coming of Christ, when Jesus comes again, and we get our new incorruptible bodies and know all things (1 Corinthians 13:12). Our spirit, if born again, is now the very Spirit of Jesus (Galatians 4:6), and has been made new and righteous now, but we will not get our souls and bodies changed until Jesus comes again. That truly is a blessed hope, as we will then live forever with Jesus and Father God in the new earth, in our new bodies, free from pain and corruption of any kind (Revelation 21:4). Boy, I can hardly wait for that Glorious day.
